# Sincerity Cupping Clinic
> Private wet cupping for women and men in Streatham, South London. Hijama is used as a secondary name for wet cupping.

## Key facts
- Name: Sincerity Cupping Clinic
- Address: 330 Streatham High Rd, London SW16 6HH, United Kingdom
- Phone: 07552 540000
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/447552540000
- Services: Women: Women's wet cupping — £45, 45 minutes; Men: Men's wet cupping — £45, 40 minutes; Women: Full spiritual appointment — £80, 90 minutes; Men: Full spiritual appointment — £80, 80 minutes
- Opening hours: daily 10:00–19:00
- Location model: the listed places are service areas for the single Streatham clinic; they are not branches or separate appointment addresses.
- Service areas: Streatham, Streatham Hill, Streatham Common, Balham, Brixton, Tooting, Clapham, Norbury, Tulse Hill, West Norwood, Herne Hill, Dulwich, Crystal Palace, Mitcham, Colliers Wood

## Safety note
Cupping is complementary care and is not a replacement for medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Independent safety information: https://www.nccih.nih.gov/health/cupping
